title: EntityFormulaDescriptor
description: Defines a virtual calculated property evaluated from other properties of the same record with the Low-Code Expression Language.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: a formula property is read-only and never stored: the runtime forces `isMappedToDbField: false`, `allowSetByClients: false`, `isRequired: false`, `isUnique: false`, and clears `defaultValue`. `expression` uses the Low-Code Expression Language (for example `If(Quantity = 0, 0, Total / Quantity)` or `FirstName & " " & LastName`) and may reference other scalar, formula, or rollup properties of the entity. `resultType` must match the property `type`. Formulas cannot be combined with `foreignKey`, `rollup`, or `collection`.

expression.description: Low-Code Expression Language expression evaluated against the current record, for example 'Round(UnitPrice * Quantity, 2)'.

resultType.description: Type of the evaluated value. Should match the owning property type.
